claims.statement: A returning agent on the current mature repository can discover the previously omitted November 27 receipt through the ordinary unselected handoff at the existing forty-path budget, without implicit receipt reading or predecessor selection.

value_frame.beneficiary: Returning coding agent on a mature target repository.
value_frame.criterion: Remove the observed receipt-path discovery blind spot at the existing forty-path budget without implicit content reading or semantic predecessor selection.
value_frame.comparison_baseline: Current first-forty alphabetical path inventory, with manual Git or directory enumeration as an available fallback.
value_frame.expected_observation: An actual no-resume handoff includes the previously omitted November 27 receipt, retains the first twenty paths, returns forty distinct paths, discloses omitted count and selects zero receipts; explicit selection still validates.
value_frame.would_change_decision_if: A decisive middle-range path is hidden, the new ordering implies priority/currentness, or manual enumeration is more appropriate.
value_frame.cost_and_downside: Trade twenty prefix hints for twenty tail hints, within the existing limit; middle remains omitted.

attributes.would_change_decision_if: A decisive middle-range path is hidden, or the selection suggests recency, authority or relevance beyond filename ordering.
attributes.mechanism: Use both lexicographic ends of the existing receipt path list rather than only its prefix.
attributes.claim_ceiling: Prospective conditional value hypothesis for the exact observed path gap. No established benefit or independent use.
